subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: rahim have you done your english lesson today asked the teacher yes sir I have done it but i havent understood some grammatical points replied rahim where is the problem said the teacher. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: "Rahim, have you done your English lesson today?" said the teacher. "Yes, sir. But I haven't understood some grammatical points," replied Rahim. "Where is the problem?" said the teacher. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 127
